title: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset
description: A collection of over 1500 one- and two-minute 64-channel EEG recordings from 109 volunteers performing motor execution and motor imagery tasks. The tasks involved opening and closing the left or right fist, or both fists or both feet, either actually or imagined, along with eyes-open and eyes-closed baseline runs. Data were recorded with the BCI2000 system and support brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: 64-channel EEG was recorded with the BCI2000 system. Each subject completed 14 runs: two one-minute baseline runs (eyes open, eyes closed) and three two-minute runs of each of four tasks. The tasks were real or imagined fist movements, cued by a target on the left or right of the screen, and real or imagined movements of both fists or both feet, cued by a target at the top or bottom of the screen.
